lines.en: I arrive at the porn shop to find a less-than-happy Makoto standing still at the counter and already hating the fact that I am, yet again, visiting her at work.
You’d think that after taking her virginity she’d be a lot more accepting of my degenerate side, but I guess she’s still just normal, old Makoto after all.
: Whaaaaaaaaaaaaat? Why are you here?
: Let me sell porn in peace.
: I can’t get enough of you, Makoto. Staying away is impossible.
: As if I’d believe that from the same guy who routinely calls girls into his office to do God-knows-what to them.
: It’s called counseling. And that sour attitude of yours makes me think it might be time for you to receive some.
: Right, right. I’m sure that would be a great conversation with Mother.
: Hey, Mom? I need counseling now.
: Why, dear? What’s wrong?
: I’m not excited enough about selling anal gangbang videos to my teacher. I must be rehabilitated.
: To be fair, your mother always seems very excited about the concept of anal gangbang videos.
: My mom is a fucking creep! She doesn’t count!
: I can hear you, Makoto!
: Shut up, Mom!
: I love you, sweetie!
: You two are so cute together.
: You are the bane of my existence.
: Wow. And to think you’d say something like that after all of the precious memories we made during the Halloween party.
: Those memories were made with fun-Makoto. Business-Makoto is currently in charge, thank you very much.
: And also, please don’t speak any further about the memories we made while my mother is right around the corner re-stocking vibrators.
: I’m honestly surprised you sell enough of those to warrant re-stocking them.
: Well, you know. It’s getting close to Christmas and the historic lack of men means a lot of women buying presents for one another.
: Right. And what better present than the gift of an orgasm?
: Right...
: Wait! Not right! There are a lot of better presents out there!
: Like...golf clubs! Or a trip to the zoo!
: Or this.
I reach behind me and manage to grab hold of a display-dildo sitting on top of a shelf, placing it directly into Makoto’s hand.
She angrily looks over it, likely pondering the kindest way to remove me from the store without her mother getting mad at her for turning away a real-live customer.
: One Christmas present, please.
: Would you like it gift-wrapped, sir?
: No thank you. I’m going to walk down the street waving it around and proclaiming my love for the girl it’s for.
: And who may I ask is this for, sir?
: Yumi Yamaguchi. Class 1-A.
: I know what fucking class she’s in! It’s mine!
: And like hell I’d believe you’d buy something like this for her of all people!
: You’re right. It’s actually for you.
: How is that any better?!
: This is the last thing I want for Christmas!
: Aww, nuts. Did Sensei steal my Christmas present idea?
: I had one wrapped up and everything.
: What kind of horrible mother would buy something like this for her daughter? Just what kind of monster do you think I am?
: Are you upset because you don’t know how to use it? I know it might look intimidating, but with a little bit of effort-
: What do you want, Mom?
: All I want is for my daughter to be happy. And if that means teaching her how to use-
: Here! You have it if you like it so much!
: Go get me a normal present like a...phone charm! Or a book!
: But dear, I already have this one. And while the idea of two of them isn’t entirely out of the question, I don’t think-
: Do you see what you’ve done?
: Oh my. I forgot you were there for a moment. How do you do, Sensei?
: I’m fine. My pants seem to keep getting tighter, though.
: Do you need any help adjusting them? I have a sewing machine upstairs and we can-
: MOM!
: Oh dear. It seems I’ve made my daughter quite angry.
: Oh! I know! How about the two of you take a little time off and go for a walk in the park?
: Wait, seriously? I can take the night off?
: Are you going to be okay here by yourself?
: Also, as my mother, shouldn’t you be preventing me from walking around in the dark with a man who just openly admitted to having an erection?
: Hey, all I said was that my pants were getting tighter. Get your mind out of the gutter, Makoto.
: I’m not worried. You’re a responsible girl and won’t let anything bad happen. I know you can hold your own out there if he tries anything.
: Oh...Umm, yeah.
: Yeah, I can hold my own. I’ll be okay.
: Besides, I think you might be a liiiiiittle too [young]for Sensei, dear~
I’m not even going to get involved in this part of the discussion.
: Mom.
: Yes, dear?
: Take this stupid dildo out of my hands so I can go for a walk with my teacher.
: Yes, dear~
Looks like I didn’t even need to worry about getting involved since the conversation resolved on its own.
I guess there’s no one out there better at dealing with Maki than the girl who’s been answering to her nonsense for the last...however many years Makoto has been alive for.
The two of us exit the porn shop and make our way to the same park where we bumped into each other quite some time ago.
Makoto shivers and sneaks closer to me, thinking I don’t notice when, in all actuality, it’s pretty obvious.
It’s a little funny how she can go from business-Makoto to fun and cute Makoto at the drop of a hat.
But I guess being alone with the person you admire is an understandable trigger.
Eventually, we wind up on a park bench drowned in the glow of a dying streetlight and bring up the one thing that’s likely been on both of our minds since I walked in tonight.
: So, how does it feel not being a virgin anymore? Any different?
: Not as different as I thought it would feel. I’m happy we went through with it, though.
: You mean how you basically blackmailed me into deflowering you while you were drunk?
: I did what I had to do, Sensei.
: If I left it up to you, you’d have probably held off until I was in college. I don’t have that kind of time.
: You definitely do have that kind of time, though.
: Also, you’re giving me way more credit than I deserve. At best, I only had a month left in me before I pulled the plug anyway.
: Hmm...I guess you don’t have as much restraint as I thought you did, then.
: Obviously not, Wicked Witch.
: I kept the costume. Want me to wear it again sometime?
: Every day for the rest of your life, please.
: Uhh...No. That’s not going to happen.
: Once a week?
: Closer but that’s still a little excessive.
: I’m glad to hear you liked it so much, though.
: Yeah. You’re cute with glasses, but without them it’s like...a whole different type of monster.
: Unfortunately, that monster comes at the cost of not being able to see anything.
: You don’t have contacts?
: I do, but...I can’t put them in. My eyes get all watery every time I try and it’s a whole thing.
: So right now, I’m pretty blind to tell you the truth. I can barely make out your face.
: And at the Halloween party?
: Oh, I had them in for that. But Miku had to hold my arms down while my mom put them in for me. It sucked.
: Well I’ll be damned. Makoto Miyamura has a weakness after all.
: I have plenty of weaknesses. I just don’t want anyone to know about them.
: That’s not healthy.
: No, it's really not.
: It’s fine to talk, you know? My office is open at any time.
: You mean your massage parlor?
: Really depends on the client, to tell the truth.
: Don’t even worry about it, Sensei. None of my problems are that serious compared to some of the other girls.
: Miku’s like Pandora’s Box once you start reading into her. But that’s something you’ll have to hear from her instead of me.
: Will I hear anything from you?
: Not just about Miku or the other girls, but yourself.
: Hmm...
Makoto stays silent for a moment, looking deeply into my eyes and trying to figure out if she wants to talk or not.
: Wanna hear about what happened after you left me on Halloween?
: I don’t like how you lead into that.
: Why? Worried someone found me covered in Sensei-juice?
: Very much, actually.
: I thought about it on the way home, but I probably shouldn’t have just...left like that.
: Probably not. But you did and that’s okay.
: I wasn’t expecting you to spend the rest of the night with me, especially after I passed out.
: So...who found you, then?
: You really wanna know?
: Just...tell me, Makoto.
: It was..
My heart drops as she prepares to tell me how things ended up that night.
The best case scenario would be someone like Futaba who probably wouldn’t share something so...intense.
But the worst case scenario would probably be Ami or Ayane or-
: Ayane...
: ...‘s butler.
: Oh my fucking god.
: Hehehe~ Had you going there, didn’t I?
: You’re evil.
: Consider that payback for harassing me at work all the time.
: You think doing this is going to make me stop?
: Probably not, but it's worth a shot.
: What did Geoffrey say? I thought he was supposed to be sick in bed or something.
: That’s the weird part. He didn’t say anything.
: He just stood in the doorway and turned around while I straightened myself out.
: I don’t even think he saw anything, to be honest. He probably just thought I was passed out from drinking too much.
: It’s not like I was still exposed or anything. And the way I limped out of there could have probably just been chalked up to, again, alcohol.
: This might just be the single most convenient thing that has ever happened to me.
: Probably. God only knows what would have happened if someone closer to you found me in that state.
: Knowing we disappeared together would have probably led to all sorts of rumors, huh?
: Right...
Something about the way she says that makes me uneasy.
It’s a confusing tone I haven’t ever heard from Makoto before- almost like she wanted something like that to happen.
She wouldn’t do that, would she?
: Umm...I didn’t get to really say it back then, but-
: Thanks...
: For finally having sex with me.
: I really, really needed to get that out of my system. And there’s no one else I would have rather done it with other than you.
: Or maybe Ryan Gosling.
: Actually, definitely Ryan Gosling.
: But you were a close second.
: Who is this Ryan guy and where can I find him?
: Hollywood, probably. Wanna catch a flight there when the borders open back up?
: I’ll be going alone. Thanks.
: Fighting to defend my honor?
: Fighting to defend my witch.
: Aaaand we're back at the witch costume, huh?...
: You really like that thing, don’t you?
: You have no idea, Makoto.
: You have no idea.
We leave the park shortly after that and, get this, hold hands for a block or two.
Obviously, Makoto is the one who initiates it. But feeling bad about the aftermath of what transpired on Halloween, I let it happen.
It feels good making her happy every once in a while.
I can just never tell if the happiness is superficial or not.
She’s...surprisingly confusing at times.
But I guess that’s just what you get when you wind up sleeping with someone smarter than you.
Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!
